response.original_text: "ANG GALING NI SEC. VINCE" Muling nabuksan ang usapin sa kalidad ng EDSA rehabilitation project matapos maiulat na ilang bahagi ng kalsadang isinailalim sa road reblocking ay nagkaroon na agad ng mga lubak at pagkabakbak sa kabila ng kamakailang pagkakagawa nito. Batay sa ulat ng 24 Oras, kabilang sa mga apektadong lugar ang ilang seksyon ng EDSA Busway at mga bahagi ng Phase 1 ng road reblocking project na sinimulan noong bisperas ng Pasko noong nakaraang taon. Tinatayang aabot sa P1.2 bilyon ang halaga ng naturang proyekto. Dahil dito, binatikos ni veteran broadcaster Jay Sonza ang Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) sa ilalim ni Secretary Vince Dizon. Sa kanyang social media post, kinuwestiyon niya kung bakit nagkaroon agad ng sira ang ilang bahagi ng EDSA sa kabila ng malaking pondong inilaan para sa rehabilitasyon. Sa ngayon, wala pang inilalabas na pahayag si Dizon kaugnay sa mga batikos at sa ulat hinggil sa kondisyon ng ilang bagong inayos na bahagi ng pangunahing lansangan sa Metro Manila.

"SEC. VINCE IS GREAT"
The issue regarding the quality of the EDSA rehabilitation project has reopened after it was reported that several parts of the road that underwent re-blocking have already developed potholes and peeling despite its recent completion.
According to a report by 24 Oras, affected areas include certain sections of the EDSA Busway and parts of Phase 1 of the road reblocking project that started on Christmas Eve of last year.
The cost of the said project is estimated to reach P1.2 billion.
As a result, veteran broadcaster Jay Sonza criticized the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) under Secretary Vince Dizon.
In his social media post, he questioned why there were already damages in some areas of EDSA despite the large funds allocated for the rehabilitation.
As of now, Dizon has not released any statement regarding the criticisms and the report concerning the condition of some newly repaired parts of the main highway in Metro Manila.

content_profile.verification_text:
"ANG GALING NI SEC. VINCE"
Muling nabuksan ang usapin sa kalidad ng EDSA rehabilitation project matapos maiulat na ilang bahagi ng kalsadang isinailalim sa road reblocking ay nagkaroon na agad ng mga lubak at pagkabakbak sa kabila ng kamakailang pagkakagawa nito.
Batay sa ulat ng 24 Oras, kabilang sa mga apektadong lugar ang ilang seksyon ng EDSA Busway at mga bahagi ng Phase 1 ng road reblocking project na sinimulan noong bisperas ng Pasko noong nakaraang taon.
Tinatayang aabot sa P1.2 bilyon ang halaga ng naturang proyekto.
Dahil dito, binatikos ni veteran broadcaster Jay Sonza ang Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) sa ilalim ni Secretary Vince Dizon.
Sa kanyang social media post, kinuwestiyon niya kung bakit nagkaroon agad ng sira ang ilang bahagi ng EDSA sa kabila ng malaking pondong inilaan para sa rehabilitasyon.
Sa ngayon, wala pang inilalabas na pahayag si Dizon kaugnay sa mga batikos at sa ulat hinggil sa kondisyon ng ilang bagong inayos na bahagi ng pangunahing lansangan sa Metro Manila.
content_profile.normalized_verification_text:
"SEC. VINCE IS GREAT"
The issue regarding the quality of the EDSA rehabilitation project has reopened after it was reported that several parts of the road that underwent re-blocking have already developed potholes and peeling despite its recent completion.
According to a report by 24 Oras, affected areas include certain sections of the EDSA Busway and parts of Phase 1 of the road reblocking project that started on Christmas Eve of last year.
The cost of the said project is estimated to reach P1.2 billion.
As a result, veteran broadcaster Jay Sonza criticized the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) under Secretary Vince Dizon.
In his social media post, he questioned why there were already damages in some areas of EDSA despite the large funds allocated for the rehabilitation.
As of now, Dizon has not released any statement regarding the criticisms and the report concerning the condition of some newly repaired parts of the main highway in Metro Manila.

According to a report by 24 Oras, affected areas include certain sections of the EDSA Busway and parts of Phase 1 of the road reblocking project that started on Christmas Eve of last year.
The cost of the said project is estimated to reach P1.2 billion.
As a result, veteran broadcaster Jay Sonza criticized the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) under Secretary Vince Dizon.
In his social media post, he questioned why there were already damages in some areas of EDSA despite the large funds allocated for the rehabilitation.
As of now, Dizon has not released any statement regarding the criticisms and the report concerning the condition of some newly repaired parts of the main highway in Metro Manila.
